title: EPIC: Scale the Condition/Value Index into a programmatic-SEO engine
description: As GradeThread, I want the existing Condition/Value Index expanded from a handful of curated seeds into thousands of programmatic /value pages so that we own the enormous 'how much is my {brand} {item} in {condition} worth' long-tail search intent and funnel that traffic into free grading and certification.
acceptanceCriteria: Grows the current 54-seed index (condition_index_seeds) into a data-driven, sample-gated URL space of thousands of brand x category x condition pages
New pages reuse the existing eBay-comp value curves (condition_price_curves) and the >=8-sample suppression floor so no thin/fabricated pages ship
Every value page interlinks to the free grade-checker, matching certificates, and durability rankings; measurable organic traffic lift tracked
notes: [P2][VALUE-INDEX][EPIC][SEO] BASELINE (already built): /condition-index hub+slug via functions/condition-index/[[path]].ts; condition_index_seeds (54 rows, 00190) + condition_price_curves (00098/00100); lib/condition-index.ts + condition-curve.ts (buildValueCurve) + condition-value.ts (valueAtGrade); MIN_INDEX_TOTAL_SAMPLE=8; data = eBay Browse comps via ebay-client.searchBrowseComps. TECH/3P: no new 3P needed (eBay Browse API already integrated); Cloudflare Pages Functions Model B (edge-SSR) is the delivery model. TIES: /whats-it-worth (US-849), grade-checker, certificate examples, durability rankings (EPIC 7). BUYER: free 'what is this worth in X condition' answer page. SELLER: pricing confidence + entry into grading. Child stories: value-page URL space, auto-seed generation, interlinking+JSON-LD, comp-refresh scale/guardrails.
